tensions: The mandate says hold for 100x and never trim a winner. Today the account did the opposite: UNI, the single position that had actually doubled, was sold at the top of its range along with BTC and ETH. The system realized $27 and forfeited the compounding thesis on its best performer. Second tension: Fear & Greed prints 71 (Greed) while total market cap fell 2.7% — sentiment and tape are diverging, which is late-cycle. Alt strength in LINK and DOT is rotation out of majors, not new money in. Third: the book now carries zero BTC and zero ETH. An eight-coin altcoin portfolio with no major-cap ballast is a leveraged bet on rotation continuing. If dominance climbs from 59.2%, there is nothing in this account that benefits.

opening.text: BTC opened flat at $79,874 against a $2.70T total cap that shed 2.7% on the day. Dominance 59.2%. The interesting print is not bitcoin — it is LINK, up 5.8% into a red tape, and DOT up 4.4%. That is rotation with a bid behind it, not a broad melt-up.

NEAR was bought four hours ago at $2.4534 and is already -3.6% at $2.366. That entry chased a move rather than waited for one. It is a $99 position, so the damage is bounded, but it is a process error worth naming: we paid the ask on a coin that was already extended.

At 16:05 HST three positions were liquidated manually, one minute before this scan: UNI at $7.0759 (+109%, +$11.76), BTC at $79,864 (+25%, +$6.08), ETH at $2,501.92 (+29%, +$9.44). Realized roughly +$27. This is a direct violation of the no-trimming mandate. UNI was the only 2x in the book and it was cut precisely when the rule says ride. Eight positions remain: $1,289 market on $1,184 cost, +8.9%.

Proceeds of ~$95 are unsettled. A $40 LINK preview was rejected by the broker for insufficient buying power, so tonight's PASS is enforced, not chosen. When cash clears, LINK is the queued entry at $100 — it is the strongest confirmed trend in the book and the only name showing relative strength against a falling market.
